FIDELITY REVIEW (F1-F20) of the literature-check write-up (note, flags, CLAUDE.md entry, README).

HIGH
F1. notes/literature-check.md:323-326 says of Kesden-Kamionkowski 'how the bound applies to a gated force was not computed.' Record: notes/velocity-gated-gravity.md section 6 (lines 218-222) maps the Kesden-Kamionkowski limit to epsilon <~ 0.2-2.5 at v* = 120 km/s and records that the 10% level is disputed (Keselman, Nusser and Peebles); panel c2-c3-c7: 'the record maps it to epsilon <~ 0.2-2.5'. The same false sentence is on wiki/dark-matter/momentum-clumping/long-range-gated-attraction.md:175, contradicting line 88 of that page. Fix: cite section 6's mapping and the dispute; say it never beats Lyman-alpha.
F2. :68-70 and :74 say 'What the check found new ... the vacuum choosing a polarization, a dark sector coupled to ours by gravity alone'; the table's C1 'Not found' lists 'the gravity-only, never-detected sector'. c1-advocate: gravity-only copies of ordinary matter 'are themselves old (mirror matter), so this part is new only as a combination'. c1-scope: mirror/twin matter 'and a preferred polarization that breaks Born duality (FLM 2015) are published; their combination with the identification is not', and calls the permanent null 'generic' (Hossenfelder 2008). Findings: Foot 1401.3965, Hossenfelder 0807.2838, Aoki-Maeda 1312.7040 are related, verified. #11 section 3 credits the preferred polarization to FLM [26S] and claims only the spontaneous reading. Fix: new only in combination with the identification.

MEDIUM
F3. :97, :124-125; README:30-31 say 'The panel changed six labels' and 'The panel labeled both partial.' Only five panel changes were applied; for 2202.06890 the one judge who addressed it (c1-content) proposed anticipates, and consolidate.py kept partial ('treated like 2202.05104 (panel c1-content proposed anticipates)'): a consolidation choice against the panel's proposal.
F4. :4-5, :17, :95-97, :205-206: 'A second agent checked every finding that carries a verdict' (and :17 'each finding') - 79 of 287 findings are single-agent (basis field), contradicting section 2; the four 'judged by their finder alone' were each re-read by a panel judge (c1-advocate and c1-scope on 2305.12593, c5 on Gasperini-Veneziano 1993, c6 on Riotto-Tkachev); Goldhaber 'read by one agent' - judge c2-c3-c7 re-read it by WebFetch and confirmed both quotes.
F5. :61-64, :360 claim every quotation in a verdict-carrying finding was found by code and 'every identifier was resolved'. recheck.out: PoS EDSU2018 047 (C5, partial) 0/4 quotes found by code, Goldhaber 0/2, both WebFetch only; 23 findings have problems, 8 identifiers do not resolve. The 'Two quotations' at :360 are six quotations from two sources.
F6. :60, :373 'written before any search ran'; preregistration.md says 'before any search agent was launched' and discloses 'written after scouting ... three papers whose abstracts I read'. README:39 states it correctly.
F7. Verdict hinges not disclosed (sections 2, 3, 5, 7): C1 - the advocate's 'dissent kept on record' and the content judge's reason for medium both give 'partly anticipated' under the other reading; C4 - judge: 'the label rests on that one reading', otherwise related only with BHM 2021 closest; C6 - if C6 is restricted to the flocks image, 'the verdict becomes related only'.
F8. :266-268 'the kept route's contents are kinetic-dominated (dual stiff -> Lambda)' reads as distinguishing the program. Mukherjee et al. section 6 (checked in source): a de Sitter Jordan frame paired with a contracting Einstein frame holding a 'stiff fluid'; the c5 judge: 'a de Sitter/contracting-stiff pairing that is the route's'; the Gasperini-Veneziano collapsing side is stiff too. What is unpublished is reaching it through a.a~ = 1 and w_eff = -w~ in Einstein gravity.
F9. Section 5 and flag 67 (flags:649-659) omit Berglund, Hubsch and Minic 2021 (arXiv:2111.14205): the c4 judge calls it the 'only work found with the program's conjugate-coordinate structure', a dark E8 on x~ identified as 'the electro-magnetic dual', the closest published form of #14 v2's S-dual image; the judge also lists work bearing on section 15's unification and round 2's 'matrix coincidence' objection: FLM 2014's dyon pairing, Lozano 1995, Harvey-Moore-Strominger 1995, Kapustin-Witten 2007. Flag 67 cites only two remarks.
F10. :208-211, :354-355; CLAUDE.md:193-195, :253-256: Khademi 2009 - the g2 verifier recorded a search-engine summary saying it 'invokes uncertainty in phase-space quantum mechanics, the one lead that might bear on C3's mechanism' (round1/g2-monopoles.verify.json); the note omits this and pairs the item with the 2008 paper, which points the other way only by the panel's inference. Unrun OpenAlex queries: oa07-1..4 (explanations of the null result), the C4 query on a magnetic counterpart for each charged particle, and three C6/C7 queries never ran (round3/oa-c2-c3-c4.json, oa-c1-c6-c7.json: 'A rerun after the reset would close that gap'); judge c2-c3-c7 cites this for C3's medium confidence; neither section 10 nor the CLAUDE.md open list mentions the rerun. Wording: 'stands until' (:211) should be 'is provisional until'.
F11. :179 calls Berard-Mohrbach 'A collision, not the conjecture'; findings.json labels it related (verified) for C2 and C4, and the c2-c3-c7 judge calls it the C2 'closest single object'.
F12. flags:632-636, flag 65: its audit says 'the panel judge for each agrees (confidence high)' but the flag includes a C6 bullet and the C6 judge rated medium; it calls Levkov, Panin and Tkachev 'the closest work' while the C6 judge names Sikivie-Yang 2009 the closest; LPT was raised from related to partial by the panel only for consistency.

LOW
F13. Flag 66, CLAUDE.md:197, README:48 drop the body's qualifier 'as a map of fluid variables'; Gasperini-Veneziano also hold the shifted dilaton fixed and say the pairing 'has no analogue in the context of the Einstein cosmology'; the c5 judge: 'right about the map, and wrong if read as a statement about its role'.
F14. :115-120, flags:609, CLAUDE.md:187: 2610.19522 (14 Oct 2026) is counted among the restatements without a caveat; c1-scope: 'Do not list it as prior to his first statement'; c1-content: it is not prior art.
F15. :76 table lists Barut 1972 as 'a superselection rule'; the abstract says there is 'no superselection rule'; the hiding comes from the +-g superposition, which the body states correctly.
F16. :189-193 Zhang et al. and Kobayashi-Perri conflict above 10^18 GeV (c2-c3-c7: the case is 'contested'); the note should say so.
F17. Section 1 (:56-58) omits consolidate rule 4 (harmonization), which lowered two verified C5 partials to related.
F18. Attribution: flag 67's audit says the remarks were 'confirmed by its verifier' but the verifier downgraded them from partial to related; in flag 68's audit it was the searcher who labeled the paper evidence-against; at :319 it was the g5 verifier who first found that Delbourgo-Lashmar's term changes the velocity-momentum relation, not the force; the C6 judge reads the term as an attraction.
F19. Cross-references: :458 cites the diameter note's section 8.2, but the citation is in section 7 and section 4; CLAUDE.md:253 points to note sections 9-10 for 'whether observation can tell...', which is not there; README:41 says 'three abstracts' but the pre-registration has Castro Perelman as 'title only'; :9-10 'the status #11 gives it' but C7 is not in #11.
F20. Minor wording: :301 heads Guth et al. as 'against the gravity-driven route' but the paper disputes Sikivie-Yang's coherence, not condensation; :43 'flagged' where 'screened' is meant; :226 Govaerts's magnetic matter has 'a photon of its own', but his paper uses two potentials of one dual electrodynamics.

Nothing found: status changes (none); #11 references accurate apart from F19; spot-checked numbers and dates correct; Delbourgo-Lashmar eq. 4, Gasperini-Veneziano section 2.2 eq. 2.32 and ref [600], Hubsch-Minic 2024 section 3 (which also writes x~ = p/epsilon), and 2212.06086 section 6.5 match.

WIKI REVIEW (W1-W20) of the wiki edits for the literature check.

HIGH
W1. wiki/cosmology/scale-factor-duality/collapse-powered-expansion.md:91 'Not found: ... and the route that remains, kinetic-dominated contents acting as a cosmological constant' - not in the note (its section 2 'Not found' for C5 is only 'the partner as the momentum description of our own universe'), and the record contradicts it: Mukherjee et al. 2024 section 6, a de Sitter frame dual to 'a stiff fluid (w = 1 ... purely kinetic scalar) that contracts toward a crunch. That is the pairing of #11 section 10's dual stiff -> Lambda with the stiff side contracting, realized in another duality'; Gasperini-Veneziano 2003: 'a contracting, kinetic-dominated universe in one description is an accelerating universe in the other'; the note's own section 6 maps gamma -> -gamma, which sends stiff to Lambda. Fix: delete the clause; clarify the note's section 6.
W2. wiki/dark-matter/momentum-clumping/long-range-gated-attraction.md:175 'how that bound applies to a force gated in relative velocity has not been computed' - line 88 of the same page applies it: 'epsilon <~ O(1): 0.2-2.5 at v* = 120 km/s' (notes/velocity-gated-gravity.md section 6). Copied from the note's section 8. Fix: point to the page's Sagittarius section; correct the note.

MEDIUM
W3. wiki/status/open-problems.md:5, 62, 64 - 'the 63 numbered flags'; 'Flags 1-58 and 63 await a ruling.'; 'the flags are the 63 items ... items 1-58 and 63 await a ruling' - stale.

Stale script counts: the-gate.md:57 'it now names all ten'; the-gate.md:61 'the elapsed times the three latest scripts print' (literature_check prints none; the three are closed_universe, velocity_gated_gravity, gate_mechanism); method/verification/independent-anchors.md:32 'seven of the ten current scripts'; status/alive.md:62 'the ten scripts in verify/'.
